sayLines.line: Filled 1L (clean — Haven well). 3L carried (3kg). (-10 kcal hauling, 1 tick.) Cistern: 24L left.
A woman, maybe 40s shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)

Travel 1 tile to trail edge.
— An old trail —
The trail splits around a boulder and rejoins — the world's oldest traffic decision. You follow the deeper-worn side.
You see smoke on the horizon. Thornfield — 10 people, 1 day in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 3 plants — 3 new to you. They've been here the whole time.
Unfamiliar unknown berries — into the bag. (Unknowns lump together; sort them at camp.)
Journal: Trampled ground. The humble weeds win.
The System notes the synergy — foraged a plant new to this ground: +1 field XP.
📓 Journal: you UNDERSTAND Green Thumb, Literally. It resonates with: something unnamed, something unnamed.
A shot in the dark — you take what's green: 3× unknown berries. Into the bag, unnamed. (Not food until identified — sort them at camp.) This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.
📋 A person, maybe 40s wants to know what's by the creek. "Just look. Come back and tell me."

Travel 2 tiles to grove.
— Nut trees —
Mast crunches underfoot — last season's nuts, sprouting or rotting. The trees don't waste anything.
Unfamiliar unknown shoots — into the bag. (Unknowns lump together; sort them at camp.)
Journal: Someone planted food here once. The trees remember.
A shot in the dark — you take what's green: 4× unknown shoots. Into the bag, unnamed. (Not food until identified — sort them at camp.) This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.

Travel 2 tiles to creek.
— Moving water —
The creek braids around gravel bars. Crawdads flick backward into the shadows of rocks.
Movement — a small fish flashing in the water.
👁 One splash and it's gone. Corner it away from the water.
✅ You saw the creek. A person, maybe 40s nods. "Good. Now we know." (+integration)
You see smoke on the horizon. Ashford — 10 people, 1 day in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 4 plants — 4 new to you. They've been here the whole time.
This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.
📖 LEARNED: Old World Caches (Level 1). You know where people hid things: under floorboards, in hollow trees, behind loose bricks.
You've learned Old World Caches — it carries Eagle Eye.

Travel 2 tiles to grove.
— Nut trees —
Bark stripped at deer height on a young hickory — teeth, winter, hunger. Somebody winters here. Maybe you will too.
You see smoke on the horizon. Stonebridge — 11 people, 1 day in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 4 plants — 4 new to you. They've been here the whole time.

Journal: Riparian ground. Water means life, and lunch.

A shot in the dark — you take what's green: 5× unknown nuts, 5× unknown nuts. Into the bag, unnamed. (Not food until identified — sort them at camp.) This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.
📋 A man, maybe 40s, with a missing fingertip wants to know what's by the creek. "Just look. Come back and tell me."
Travel 1 tile to Haven.
You keep a day's food (1400 kcal) — nothing extra for the pantry this time.
3 unprocessed hauls onto the counter — the clock is ticking.
Someone by the fire nods at the counter. "We pool food here. Keep what you need for the road — the rest feeds everyone, once it's food."
Nobody at the fire knows your haul any better than you do. It'll be your own hands that teach you.
You walk back into Haven. 3 Codex entries. The village is glad to see you.
A woman, maybe 40s heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself." The pantry won't fill itself.
A man, maybe 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin." The pantry won't fill itself.
A woman, maybe 30s, with sun-creased eyes walks away from Haven. They don't look back.
A woman, maybe 50s heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." The pantry won't fill itself.
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits." The pantry won't fill itself.
A woman, maybe 30s, with ink-stained fingers heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going." The pantry won't fill itself.
A man, maybe 40s, with a missing fingertip heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going." The pantry won't fill itself.
A man, maybe 40s, with a crooked nose is tending the fire, coaxing it steady.
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
You eat Dried meat (600 kcal).
"You haven't earned that yet," A woman, maybe 40s says. (Trust too low.)
A man, maybe 40s, with a crooked nose is tending the fire, coaxing it steady.
— DUSK — Animals stir again. Shadows lengthen.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
A woman, maybe 40s looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
💧 A woman, maybe 50s returns with water: +2 clean.
💧 A woman, maybe 30s, with ink-stained fingers returns with water: +3 clean.
💧 A man, maybe 40s, with a missing fingertip returns with water: +3 clean.
A man, maybe 40s, with a crooked nose is tending the fire, coaxing it steady.
— NIGHT — Camp. Rest — or risk the dark.
Night settles. The fire is the whole world now. No watches posted. The dark feels bigger than it should.
